test_title: PYST 150: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 02 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '21'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/082f5b6dd6d8b3a9c9097ed42968a791b29a6496b34f1ab714adcfa07ef90c4e.png]
solution:
As 20 and 18 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 21 and 22 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/082f5b6dd6d8b3a9c9097ed42968a791b29a6496b34f1ab714adcfa07ef90c4e.png] 

Hence, ‘**22**’ is the correct answer.
